Consider the following regarding the maintenance of financial records (Rule 180):
I. Every recognized private school must submit an annual return to the Director.
II. The return must include a statement of the fees collected and the salaries disbursed.
III. Unaudited accounts are acceptable if signed by the Chairman of the managing committee. Which of the above statements is/are correct?

questions.explanation_english: I and II only Rule 180 of DSER 1973 requires all recognized private schools to submit detailed annual financial returns to the Director, including audited statements of fees collected and staff salaries disbursed. questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements about 'Suspension':
I. Suspension is not a penalty.
II. An employee under suspension must mark attendance in the school daily.
III. Subsistence allowance can be increased or decreased after the first three months of suspension based on the delay in inquiry.
IV. A suspended teacher is allowed to take up private employment. Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I and III only
II and IV only
I, III, and IV only
questions.explanation_english: Statements I and III are correct. Suspension is generally an interim measure pending inquiry rather than a final penalty. Under the applicable service framework, subsistence allowance may be reviewed after the initial period, including in light of whether delay in the disciplinary proceeding is attributable to the employee. A suspended employee is not automatically required to attend school daily in every case, and suspension does not give unrestricted permission to take up private employment.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और III सही हैं। निलंबन सामान्यतः जाँच लंबित रहने के दौरान की प्रशासनिक स्थिति है, न कि अंतिम दंड। लागू नियमों के अनुसार प्रारंभिक तीन महीनों के बाद जाँच में देरी और उसके कारणों को देखते हुए निर्वाह भत्ते में परिवर्तन संभव है। कथन II को निरपेक्ष रूप में सही नहीं माना जा सकता, क्योंकि निलंबन की शर्तें और अधिकारी के निर्देश निर्णायक होते हैं। कथन IV भी गलत है; निलंबन कर्मचारी को बिना अनुमति स्वतंत्र निजी रोजगार करने का अधिकार नहीं देता।
questions.topic: Delhi Education Act, 1973 and Delhi School Education Rules, 1973
key_facts: Correct answer: B. I and III only

Statements I and III are correct. Suspension is generally an interim measure pending inquiry rather than a final penalty. Under the applicable service framework, subsistence allowance may be reviewed after the initial period, including in light of whether delay in the disciplinary proceeding is attributable to the employee. A suspended employee is not automatically required to attend school daily in every case, and suspension does not give unrestricted permission to take up private employment.

questions.question_english: Under the provisions governing schools on DDA land, what condition must a private unaided school fulfill before hiking its fees?

It must secure prior approval from the Director of Education.

Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The Head of a recognized private school is responsible for maintaining the confidential reports of the staff.
Reason (R): Under DSER 1973, the Head of the School has administrative control over all school records and employee evaluations.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A Under the Delhi School Education Rules, 1973, the Head of School is administrative custodian of all institutional records and staff evaluations. Consequently, the Head of School is responsible for recording and maintaining annual confidential performance reports of teaching and non-teaching staff, making the assertion true and correctly explained by the underlying rule.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं और कारण, अभिकथन की व्याख्या करता है। कर्मचारियों की गोपनीय रिपोर्टें संस्थागत सेवा-अभिलेखों का हिस्सा हैं और उनका उचित संरक्षण विद्यालय प्रशासन की जिम्मेदारी में आता है। विद्यालय प्रमुख की अभिलेखीय और मूल्यांकन-संबंधी प्रशासनिक भूमिका इसी जिम्मेदारी को आधार प्रदान करती है। गोपनीय रिपोर्टों को साधारण सार्वजनिक रिकॉर्ड की तरह संभालना उचित नहीं होगा।

कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following qualifications required for a person to be appointed as the Presiding Officer of the Delhi School Tribunal:
I. He has held the office of a District Judge.
II. He has held a similar judicial office.
III. He is a retired Principal of a government school. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: I and II only Section 11(1) of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 specifies that a person shall not be qualified for appointment as the Presiding Officer of the Delhi School Tribunal unless they have held the office of a District Judge or an equivalent judicial office. School principals lack required judicial qualifications, validating statements I and II.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और II सही हैं। ट्रिब्यूनल के पीठासीन अधिकारी के लिए न्यायिक अनुभव की पात्रता निर्धारित है, जैसे जिला न्यायाधीश या समान न्यायिक पद धारण करने का अनुभव। केवल सरकारी विद्यालय का सेवानिवृत्त प्रधानाचार्य होना इस न्यायिक पद के लिए वैधानिक योग्यता नहीं है। इससे ट्रिब्यूनल की अर्ध-न्यायिक प्रकृति स्पष्ट होती है।

questions.question_english: Under the Delhi School Education Act, 1973, which of the following entities is explicitly designated to regulate education in all schools in Delhi?
options_english: The Director of Education
The Central Board of Secondary Education
The Administrator
The Minister of Education, GNCTD
questions.explanation_english: The Administrator Section 3(1) of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 explicitly designates the Administrator as the executive authority responsible for regulating education in all schools within the Union territory of Delhi. The Administrator exercises overarching regulatory control through prescribed rules, policy directives, and structural supervision over government, municipal, aided, and recognized private educational institutions operating across the territory.
questions.explanation_hindi: अधिनियम की धारा 3(1) प्रशासक को दिल्ली संघ राज्य क्षेत्र के विद्यालयों में शिक्षा विनियमित करने के लिए निर्दिष्ट करती है। शिक्षा निदेशक प्रशासनिक और कार्यान्वयन संबंधी महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, लेकिन प्रश्न अधिनियम में स्पष्ट रूप से नामित प्राधिकारी पूछता है। इसलिए सही विकल्प “प्रशासक” है, न कि CBSE या शिक्षा मंत्री।
